gloss: to the end; persistently; strictly; only

definitions.explanation: Without giving up; continuing firmly until a goal is achieved.
Used to emphasize limitation - that something is limited to a particular scope or purpose.

examples.japanese: あくまで{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{通|とお}した。
examples.english: They persistently stuck to their own opinion.

examples.japanese: これはあくまで{参考|さんこう}です。
あくまで{個人|こじん}の{見解|けんかい}ですが...
examples.english: This is strictly my personal opinion, but...

notes:
KANJI:
Can be written as {飽|あ}くまで, though hiragana is more common.

USAGE PATTERNS:

Sense 1 (persistent):
・あくまで{抵抗|ていこう}する (to resist to the end)
・あくまで{否定|ひてい}する (to persistently deny)
・あくまで{戦|たたか}う (to fight to the bitter end)

Sense 2 (limitation/qualifier):
・あくまで{参考|さんこう} (strictly for reference)
・あくまで{私見|しけん}ですが (this is just my opinion, but...)
・あくまで{目安|めやす} (just a guideline)
・あくまで{予定|よてい} (just a tentative plan)

NUANCE:
In sense 2, often used to disclaim responsibility or soften a statement. Very common in business Japanese to hedge assertions.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・どこまでも - to the end, everywhere
・{断|だん}じて - firmly, absolutely
